assessments.rationale: The cited ideal-sheet convention differs from the source number by a factor of 2.714829.
assessments.limitation: A theoretical two-face area is not a measured accessible surface area or a one-face footprint.

next_gate.question: Which physical quantity did 7,140 m²/g describe?
next_gate.required_record: Original numerical reference, mass basis and face convention
next_gate.acceptance_condition: The same quantity and units reconcile the source and reference, or the source number is corrected.

assessments.technology: CVD film quality and research lineage
assessments.rationale: A production-method label does not establish universal quality; corporate priority needs a specific research-to-company chain.
assessments.limitation: Inspected paper abstracts cannot characterize a current production lot or resolve licensing history.

next_gate.question: Which quality and lineage claims can be tied to a named process version?
next_gate.required_record: Spatial sampling plan, defect criteria, yield record and attribution documents
next_gate.acceptance_condition: Quality is bounded by sampling and acceptance criteria; priority names the precise advance and attributable party.

assessments.technology: Task energy of a graphene cooker
assessments.rationale: At fixed assumed task efficiency, changing electrical power changes idealized time but not task energy.
assessments.limitation: The illustrative heat-capture values are not assigned to a product.

next_gate.question: Does the device use less wall energy at the same task endpoint?
next_gate.required_record: Versioned comparator/load/endpoints, repeated wall-energy measurements and uncertainty
next_gate.acceptance_condition: Comparison holds the useful task constant and reports all runs, measurement uncertainty and excluded conditions.

assessments.technology: Radiator surface and optical assembly claims
assessments.rationale: Surface conditions and the optical assembly need device-specific evidence.
assessments.limitation: Current manufacturer pages may describe a different product version; no safety or optical certification is established.

next_gate.question: What exactly was evaluated on the reported product version?
next_gate.required_record: Version-specific surface map, applicable independent assessment and optical test definition
next_gate.acceptance_condition: A conclusion identifies the evaluated surfaces, access/contact conditions, optical endpoint and unresolved hazards.
